questionText:
Identify from the options given below, the correct characteristic of a good
brand name.

options.text:
The brand name should be lengthy, easy to pronounce, spell, recognize
and remember.
options.explanation: Incorrect. A good brand name should be short, not lengthy.

options.text: A brand name should be non-distinctive.
options.explanation: Incorrect. A good brand name must be distinctive and unique to stand out.

options.text: The chosen name should have staying power.
options.explanation: Correct. A good brand name must possess staying power so it does not lose relevance quickly.

detailedSolution:

- Option B: Incorrect. A good brand name must be distinctive and unique to stand out.
- Option C: Correct. A good brand name must possess staying power so it does not lose relevance quickly.
- Option D: Incorrect. A brand name must be versatile so that it can accommodate new products under the same brand.

questionText:
Identify the incorrect statement related to "difference between delegation
and decentralisation".

options.text:
Delegation is a compulsory act; decentralization is an optional policy
decision.
options.explanation: Incorrect because this is a true statement (delegation is compulsory; decentralisation is optional).

options.text: Delegation has narrow scope; decentralization has wider scope.
options.explanation: Incorrect because this is a true statement (delegation is narrow; decentralisation is wide in scope).
Incorrect because this is a true statement regarding purpose.

options.text:
Delegation grants less control by superiors, hence greater freedom of
action; decentralization gives more control to superiors, hence less
freedom of action.
options.explanation: Correct. Statement D is false because superiors retain MORE control in delegation and LESS control in decentralisation.

detailedSolution:

- Option A: Incorrect because this is a true statement (delegation is compulsory; decentralisation is optional).
- Option B: Incorrect because this is a true statement (delegation is narrow; decentralisation is wide in scope).
- Option C: Incorrect because this is a true statement regarding purpose.
- Option D: Correct. Statement D is false because superiors retain MORE control in delegation and LESS control in decentralisation.
